PLAN YOUR NEXT PROJECT

Planning a local home service visit

Prepare a clear request, compare the scope of work and keep your project information together.

Looking for the former HomPilot contractor directory? Those listings are no longer available on this site. These guides help you prepare a service request; HomPilot now presents its business software and Maya AI agents for home service companies.

What to include in your request

Start with the complete service address, municipality and postal code. Tell the provider whether the property is a house, apartment or multi-unit building, which part of the property needs attention and who can provide access. A city name alone does not establish that a company covers your address.

What to clarify with the provider

Ask each company to confirm its service area, appointment availability and any travel charges before booking. Share parking or building-access instructions and agree on a contact person. For a project spanning several addresses, list each property separately so the company can plan the visits.

Before confirming a visit

Confirm that the company serves your address, the appointment window and the contact person. Request a written proposal covering the agreed work and exclusions. Save messages, documents and photos so both sides can refer to the same information. This guide does not list local providers or confirm their availability.

Run a home service business?

HomPilot helps your team manage calls, quotes, appointments and follow-ups. Maya collects customer requests in English and French, while HomPassport keeps property information and service history together. Explore the agents or book a demo to discuss your workflow.
